git_rationale.root_cause_commit: The mcp__happy__change_title interception in messageToEvent.ts was added as part of the initial title change feature implementation
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: messageToEvent.ts intercepted the tool call and converted it to a generic 'message' event, which rendered as a simple gray text line instead of a proper tool block. This prevented the knownTools.tsx config from being used.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: By removing the interception, tool calls for change_title now flow through the normal tool rendering pipeline (reducer.ts Phase 1 tool processing -> ToolView -> knownTools.tsx lookup), rendering as a visible 'Change Title' tool block with icon and proper status.

Note: Issue 1 (MCP STDIO bridge connection) was not fixed in this pass -- it requires runtime debugging. If the MCP connection still fails, the tool call will show an error in the tool block, which is better than the previous invisible failure.
implementation_notes: Issue 1 (MCP STDIO bridge connection failure) was analyzed but not fixed. The architecture (STDIO bridge -> HTTP MCP server) looks correct in code: the bridge at happyMcpStdioBridge.ts creates a StreamableHTTPClientTransport pointing to the URL from startHappyServer.ts, and the server handles requests in stateless mode. The failure likely occurs at runtime -- possible causes: (a) the compiled bridge file dist/codex/happyMcpStdioBridge.mjs may have module resolution issues, (b) timing issue where bridge tries to connect before server is ready, (c) fetch() not available in the bridge's Node.js context. This needs runtime debugging with daemon logs.

The 8 pre-existing TypeScript errors (all about AttachmentMetadata import from @slopus/happy-wire) are unrelated to this fix. My changes reduced errors from 11 to 8 by fixing the 3 type errors that existed in the original messageToEvent.ts.

recommendations: Investigate MCP STDIO bridge connection failure separately -- check daemon logs for '[happy-mcp]' prefixed errors when a session starts
Consider eliminating the STDIO bridge entirely and registering the change_title tool directly via Claude SDK's mcpServers config with an inline handler, avoiding the HTTP hop
